status: independent public-figure-constrained research proxy; NOT validated VCSEL model

source.title: A 112 Gb/s Radiation-Hardened Mid-Board Optical Transceiver in 130-nm SiGe BiCMOS for Intra-Satellite Links
source.reuse: CC BY 4.0; original figure already retained with adjacent notice

temperature_C.provenance: Fig.8A blue legend; only static curves. Fig.8B temperature is not specified.

iv.provenance: approximate manual Fig.8A measured light-blue dots, 25 C
iv.outside_scope: 0-0.4mA artificial linear numerical continuation; >8mA extends final slope; no reverse-breakdown or thermal validity

pi.provenance: Fig.8A blue pixel trace, measured/model curves overlap; extraction details and pixels in CSV; zero-current zero-power is numerical assumption
pi.outside_scope: linear continuation above last point is unsupported; no thermal rollover, spontaneous emission or absolute calibration verification

CJ_F.provenance: engineering sensitivity choices; NOT disclosed by source and NOT fitted from S11

series_resistance_ohm.provenance: no added resistor; measured terminal I-V already contains static series loss; not a claim that physical series resistance is zero

dynamic.name: figure3mA_proxy
dynamic.parameter_provenance: all three parameters jointly derived by deterministic coarse-to-fine least-squares magnitude-only shape approximation to manually digitized Fig.8B 3mA points; none disclosed by authors
dynamic.fit_validation: in-sample graphical shape agreement only; no held-out device measurements or phase validation
dynamic.application: fixed normalized shape applied to static P(I); no bias interpolation; only constant 3mA reference shape across whole swing
dynamic.double_counting: published electrical-to-optical S21 is not de-embedded; applying this shape to conductive current after separate assumed CJ can double-count electrical roll-off. No unique correction is possible without same-device S11/complex S21.

lowpass8GHz_assumed.provenance: engineering sensitivity assumption, not extracted intrinsic pole

static.provenance: instantaneous P(I) control; no optical dynamics
